profile.headline: .NET Application Developer/Agile Team Member II at Farmers Insurance
profile.summary:
Create.  Code.  Teach.

I'm Kelly, a multi-talented web application developer who is passionate about website design and helping others.   I do love to inspire, motivate and teach others so that they can reach their goals.  I also love to design and develop websites for personal branding, small businesses and non-profits.

positions.title: Agile Dev Team Member II/.NET Application Developer II
Application Developer I
positions.description: Codes instructions for computer programs/objects/components; configures 3rd party packaged software for the environment; tests and implements all changes to ensure they meet specifications. Documents program logic and flow according to the standard procedures and convention and implements programs according to installation standards and conventions. Quality checks program code, related objects and documentation. Responds to Production Support issues. Works with business as required. Performs final evaluation of packaged software.

positions.title: Owner / Web Developer / Consultant
positions.description: Part time free lance business in which I provide basic support services for small businesses and individual computer owners: web site design, software installation, hardware installation and custom builds, routine maintenance, instruction, troubleshooting.

positions.title: Volunteer Webmaster
positions.description:
Maintain and update WordPress website.
Develop marketing promotions and mailings using Constant Contacts.
Develop new web add on site projects using HTML 5.0, CSS 3.0, Adobe Forms

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
Contract-to-hire position at Farmers Insurance.

Help plan, design, develop, test, debug, and deploy highly-available applications using the .NET Framework technology with backend on AS400 system and IBM DB2 and Oracle database technologies.  Support of software development efforts and enhancements involving a critical business system.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
Contract Position at AmTrust Financial.

Develop and troubleshoot back end code in VB.Net and ASP.NET for insurance quote and policy coverages rating engine for insurance company web application.

positions.title: Entry Level Web Developer
positions.description:
Contract position at Waxman Industries.

� Troubleshoot and develop code to customize a SharePoint extranet/intranet site to client's
       requirements using ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, XML, XSL, SharePoint Designer 2010, web parts, lists, and
       calendars.
   � Develop queries in SQL for database conversion project.

positions.title: Student Assistant/Faculty Assistant/Tutor
positions.description:
� Greets visitors and answer general questions.
� Assists faculty with lab coverage and grading assignments, tests, labs and other material in algebra,
   statistics, and various computer science courses.
� Assists students through one-on-one tutoring, lab settings and small group studies in algebra, statistics,
   and various computer science, business and writing courses.
� Completes other projects and duties as assigned.
� Work closely with coworkers to improve tutorial services provided to the students.
� Interview potential Tutors, mentor new tutors.

positions.title: Team Technical Leader
positions.description:
� Project leader of a team of five students responsible for redesigning and implementing this non-profit's
 website pursuant to client's needs and requirements.
� Design web page mock ups and code approved web pages according to the organization's web editor
 limitations, restrictions and marketing guidelines.
� Develop workarounds to the limitations of the web editor to increase web presence and overall quality of
 the website.
� Provide necessary coordination and planning between the client and team.
� Supervised project team and assigned tasks based on their strengths and abilities.
� Report issues with the website to the client.
� Provide post-project support to the client to ease the transition.
� Instruct the client on HTML and CSS basics to enable client to effectively maintain and update the website
 without the need for outside help.

projects.title: DeVry University Cleveland AITP Student Chapter
projects.description: Student organization on campus that I founded.

projects.title: Dress for Success Cleveland
projects.description: This started out as my senior project where we were tasked with re-designing their website to improve web presence.  The project had specific branding requirements as well as limitations in that the site platform was an outdated template system that only allowed content modification to preset pages.    After the project was completed, I stayed on as pro bono webmaster to maintain the website for the organization.
